_doc: Roles of the demo app (decision B2: prepared before the demo). `pls setup --roles demo/roles.json` looks up each group by name once and stores the ids in the machine profile; every `pls init` uses them (docs/setup.md). P2 may use only these roles. Demo stage: role tests are deferred, so only `admin` (your own user) needs an API key; the two groups only need to exist so the app's permissions can be deployed. They need no members.

admin.description: The person running the demo: manages the app's sites (bootstrap, apply, export). Use your own Pleasanter user; it needs site-management rights on the demo folder.

somu.description: 総務部: registers equipment and loans, marks loans as returned.

staff.description: 一般社員: may only view the equipment register.
